xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ScheduleOfPaymentOfCouponOrInt:
The coupon/interest on the Debentures is payable by the Company on a monthly basis in accordance with the Transaction Documents.
Principal Payment Date: The principal amount of the Debentures shall be redeemed by the Company in accordance with the Transaction Documents as follows: 1. Series I Debentures and Series II Debentures: Payable in full on the Series I Final Redemption Date and the Series II Final Redemption Date, respectively. 2. Series III Debentures: Payable in 2 (two) instalments, being 50% (fifty percent) of the principal amounts of the Series III Debentures upon the expiry of 30 (thirty) months from the Deemed Date of Allotment (i.e., May 25, 2029) and the balance 50% (fifty percent) of the principal amounts of the Series III Debentures on the Series III Final Redemption Date.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfChargeOrSecurityOfCre: The Debentures and the outstanding amounts in respect thereof shall be secured on or prior to the Deemed Date of Allotment by way of (a) a first ranking exclusive and continuing charge to be created in favour of the debenture trustee ("Debenture Trustee") pursuant to an unattested deed of hypothecation, executed or to be executed and delivered by the Company over certain identified book debts/loan receivables of the Company as described therein (the "Hypothecated Assets"), and (b) such other security interest as may be agreed between the Company and the holders of the Debentures. The value of the Hypothecated Assets shall at all times, commencing from the Deemed Date of Allotment until all amounts in respect of the Debentures have been repaid in full, be at least 1.05 (one decimal zero five) times the value of the aggregate outstanding amounts in respect of the Debentures of all series of the Debentures.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ParticularsOfSpecialRightOrInt: None. All rights/interests/privileges of the holders of the Debentures are set out in the debenture trust deed ("DTD") executed/to be executed between the Company and the Debenture Trustee and the other transaction documents executed/to be executed in respect of the Debentures (together with the DTD, the ("Transaction Documents").
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfDelayForAPeriodOfMore: On the occurrence of a payment default, interest at 2% (two percent) per annum over the applicable Interest Rate will be payable on the outstanding principal amounts in respect of the Debentures from the date of the occurrence of such payment default until such payment default is cured or the Debentures are fully redeemed by the Company (whichever is earlier).
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfRedemptionOfPreferenc: Each of the Series I Debentures, the Series II Debentures, and Series III Desbentures shall be redeemed on a pari passu basis by the Company by making the payment of the outstanding principal amounts as on the dates mentioned in item 6 above, in accordance with the DTD and the other Transaction Documents.

Series II Debentures: The proposed date of maturity shall be the date occurring on the expiry of a period of 27 months from the Deemed Date of Allotment, being February 23, 2029 or such other date as may be set out in the Transaction Documents ("Series II Final Redemption Date")

Series III Debentures: The proposed date of maturity shall be the date occurring on the expiry of a period of 33 months from the Deemed Date of Allotment, being August 24, 2029 or such other date as may be set out in the Transaction Documents ("Series III Final Redemption Date")
